decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed change of use from B1 (office) to D1 (education) at first floor level is not considered to be acceptable in principle. The proposal would result in a loss of B1 office space provided within the development, and would be harmful to the original permission that sought to maximise employment capacity on the site for the overall mixed use development. The proposal has not demonstrated that the B1 office space could be provided elsewhere on site. The proposal is therefore considered contrary to the terms of the original section 106 agreement and Policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) Unitary Development Plan and Policies E1 (Maintaining Employment Capacity), E2 (Locations for Employment) and E3 (Local Employment Opportunities) of the Employment Development Plan Document, Policy 3B.2 (Office Demand and Supply) of the London Plan and Policy M2 of the Brentford Area Action Plan.

Condition : 2 - 2.	It has not been demonstrated that the change to an educational use within 429m? of an existing office building would not adversely impact on the surrounding streets and road network. The application has not provided a Travel Assessment, Travel Plan and it cannot be determined that the proposal would not adversely impact on the transport network. No disabled parking or cycle parking has been provided. The proposal is therefore considered to be contrary to Policy T.4.4 of the Unitary Development Plan, Policies 3C.3 (Sustainable Transport in London) and 3C.23 (Parking Strategy) of the London Plan and Policy BAAP4 of the Brentford Area Action Plan.
description: Change of use from B1(office) to D1(educational) use at first floor level
